GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Electrical & lighting

We plan commercial electrical and lighting work around how each area is used. We identify affected fittings and circuits, confirm the required isolation and coordinate access with your manager. Outdoor and coastal lighting needs a check of the fitting specification, exposure and mounting condition.

What we can look after

  • Interior, entry, car park and external lighting maintenance.
  • Fault investigation and replacement of agreed electrical fittings.
  • Lighting upgrades with existing controls and site use considered.

Planning the work

  1. We review the fault, existing equipment and the areas affected by the work.
  2. We agree isolation periods and coordinate access with occupants.
  3. We test the completed work and provide the relevant handover records.

Questions about this service

Can lighting work be arranged around trading hours?+

We discuss your opening hours, access restrictions and any required power interruption when preparing the scope. We can then plan the sequence and confirm available attendance times before booking the work.
